dct_description_sm: Shows the world as a circular map set in ill. field; has azimuthal view centered on North Pole and extending 60 ̊south of the equator.
Includes ill. and compass roses. Mythological scenes in corners most likely engraved by Jacob Harrewyn.
Shows California as a labeled island with a flat northern coast and place names.
Shirley, R.W. Mapping the world (4th ed.) 582
Text in Latin. Title in early Dutch.
